description:
Install measured CPU kernel winners and crossover boundaries through the existing offline tuning system and verify that production consumers execute them.

## Background

The workspace has conservative and measured tuning profiles plus compile-time and runtime dispatch boundaries. Standalone gf2-core feature defaults, dependency feature unification and the gf2_tuning_baked configuration affect which path is reached. Optimization must consume the canonical capability and profile mechanisms.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-07: Inventory the affected public-entry-point-to-kernel routes, including feature gates, runtime feature checks, size thresholds and compile-time baked selectors. Show which route each measured production workload executes.

- [hard] REQ-08: Calibrate candidate selectors using the frozen protocol, independently reconfirm the resulting profile, and commit the versioned profile with producing-tool behavioral identity and linked receipts. Preserve conservative values for no-win or non-monotone domains.

- [hard] REQ-09: Benchmark conservative portable, tuned portable and native-optimized builds separately, with equivalent competitor targeting opportunities. Include small input/dispatch overhead and holdout workload cells so calibration is not evaluated only on its training measurements.

- [hard] REQ-10: Verify missing-feature and unknown-host behavior selects the established deterministic fallback. Cover standalone gf2-core and actual gf2-coding/gf2-sim dependency builds; do not rely on --all-features to imply a baked profile.

- [hard] REQ-11: Remove superseded private thresholds or record a named tracked convergence exception. Keep calibration explicit and offline rather than running benchmarks at library initialization or build time.

- [hard] REQ-12: Limit this task's calibration ownership to core kernel selectors and their production call routes. Decoder batch/layout/fallback and worker selectors are calibrated within decoder delivery through the same canonical tuning mechanism; neither track creates private selectors. Final integration independently verifies both tracks.
title: Calibrate production dispatch for the 5900X
